packageRules.description: gitops/postgresql-upgrade-test rehearses a Postgres major upgrade with pinned old and new images; they are bumped by hand together with gitops/postgresql when the next major is rehearsed
Plex tags are <major>.<minor>.<patch>.<build>-<git hash>; compare the numbers, ignore the hash and per-arch tags
Our Home Assistant image (AurimasNav/home-assistant-image) is tagged <Home Assistant version>.<build number>, e.g. 2026.11.1.2: four numbers, compared as such

hairsera images are private on ghcr.io and Renovate has no ghcr login, so every run warned "Failed to look up docker package ... no-result". hairsera's own deploy workflow already sets these tags here on each build, so Renovate skips them

VSeerr tags are <Seerr release>-vseerr.<VSeerr MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH>, e.g. 3.5.1-vseerr.0.4.2: plain semver. The '-vseerr' part makes every tag a semver pre-release, so ignoreUnstable is off. Only that form is followed: main/sha-* tags and the old 3.5.1-vseerr.<build> tags (which sort above the new ones) are never offered
hass-otbr-docker also publishes git-hash tags (e.g. 7781566); only follow vX.Y.Z releases

Hermes Agent moved from date tags (v2026.9.24) to SemVer (v0.21.6 onwards) in October 2026. Renovate ranks v2026 above v0, so it took the old date tag for the newest and opened no PR for 15 releases. From a v0.x pin it would offer v2026.9.24 back as a major update; today only the default maxMajorIncrement (500) hides that. Never offer the old date tags
Immich server and machine-learning must run the same release: one PR for both
Immich Postgres (<pg>-vectorchord<x>-pgvector<y>): a Postgres major needs a dump/restore and a VectorChord bump an ALTER EXTENSION, so it is upgraded by hand following Immich's compose file

Bambu Studio tags are v<MM>.<mm>.<pp>.<build> with leading zeros (v02.09.01.70): four numbers, compared as such. Betas are GitHub pre-releases and are skipped. A bump makes the Hermes bambu-studio init container download and self-test the new slicer
iac/ uses OpenTofu: resolve providers and modules from the OpenTofu registry
required_version is an OpenTofu range, not a Terraform release; the tofu binary is pinned in .github/workflows/iac.yaml
